findings: SUCCESSOR F0 (IMPORTANT — the predecessor's status file UNDERSTATED what is on disk): `outputs_written` was empty, but signposts.json, build-signposts.mjs, the province/field/engine/harness consumers and road-directions.json ALL EXIST and are COMMITTED (signposts landed in 5d74d9b 'Four posts, with times on them'; road-directions.json in 58b6c6e). Do not rebuild any of them. `outputs_written` is now accurate.

SURVEY F1: game/data/world/roads.json ships 10 legs (25,056.9 m trunk), 9 waystations, 2 named_routes (crossing 6816 m / 56.8 walk-min; long_way 9367.3 m). Before this piece there were ZERO signposts anywhere in the repo — the L2 layer of RI-WLD06 did not exist at all.

SURVEY F2: pois.json is STALE against roads.json. pois.json declares 8 waystations named 'Wayshrine of the Root (Stormhold-Helstrom)', 'Pole Camp', 'Vat-Keeper's Hut', 'Kiln Post'; roads.json's 9 are 'Legion Milepost', 'Ash Shelter', 'Corpse-Lily Shrine' x2, 'Welkynd Shrine', 'Lichen Post', 'Fired-Cold Well', 'Tide-Pole Post', 'Stilt-Rest'. Only 'Tide-Pole Post' and 'Stilt-Rest' agree. build-pois.mjs derives from roads.json, so pois.json was built against an older roads.json and never rebuilt.

SURVEY F3: roads.json waystations were ORPHAN DATA in the running game — only tools read them (build-pois, build-hearths, scale-audit); nothing in game/src placed or drew one. The 9 waystation signposts are the first world-side consumer.

SURVEY F4: tools/harness/viewpoints-province.json's 17 viewpoints carry anchor: 'region_blackwood' etc. None of those 13 states exist in game/data/states. They are ALSO never read: the file's own consumer, tools/world/province-shots.mjs, calls loadState('default') and ignores anchor entirely; shoot.mjs would call hOpt('loadState', ...) which swallows the failure AND the file has 0 viewpoints with a `camera` key, so shoot.mjs cannot shoot it at all. The anchors are orphan fields, not missing states.

SURVEY F5: the renderer consumes roads.json properly — field.setRoads() builds roadSegs/roadGrid/spans, province.js _spans() builds deck slabs, parapets and piers per tile. That is the pattern the signpost consumer copies.

SURVEY F6: the pattern for a READABLE world object already existed — engine.openWrit()/_writSync() pushes a model with a `record: {name, lines}` block into renderer.ui.setModel(). signRead mirrors it exactly, which makes the sign's text DRAWN rather than orphan text.

MID-RUN CORRECTION (carried): S30 (no map at all) was OVERRULED BY THE OWNER 2026-08-07 and superseded by S35 — there IS a map, confined to ground already walked, with no marker, route line, distance readout, or square for a place never stood in. Comments in build-signposts.mjs, province.js, engine.js and field.js were corrected. NOTHING in this piece was wasted: S35 states outright that wayfinding must still work with the map closed.

SUCCESSOR F7: engine.js:1557 `directionsFor(npcId)` already exists and is consumed by character/converse.js:292 — but it reads ONLY the quest-derived directionsIndex (q.directions on 32 main quests). road-directions.json has NO reader yet. That is the outstanding CONSUMPTION hole for this piece.
